title: Backups & restore
subtitle: Servers that have run and are stopped are backed up daily. A backup is also created before long-term idle reclamation. Stop the server before restoring a world.
not_yours_body: Only the owner or an admin can view, restore and delete this server's backups.
history_note: Backups can be restored until they expire, then they are cleaned up automatically. Each server keeps only its most recent manual backups and its most recent scheduled backups (older ones of the same kind are removed once a new one finishes), and its last 3 pre-restore snapshots. Backups you no longer need can be deleted by hand.
reason_released: Archived when given up or deleted
backup_started: The backup task has started. Progress is available under Recent operations.
backup_world_busy: A backup, restoration, or world export is in progress. Wait for the current operation to complete before starting a backup.
backup_requires_stopped: Stop the server before backing it up.
export_world_hint: Package the current world as a .tar.gz file for download.
export_requires_stopped: Stop the server before exporting its world.
export_world_busy: The world is undergoing backup, restoration, or export. Wait for the current operation to complete before starting an export.
export_another: Another download is being prepared. Retry after preparation completes.
export_progress_world: The world is being archived. The download starts automatically after preparation. Keep the page open. The server cannot start until the download ends.
export_progress_backup: The backup download is being prepared. Transfer starts automatically after preparation. Keep the page open.
export_started_world: Download started: your browser is saving {{filename}}. The server can start again once it finishes.
export_started_backup: Download started: your browser is saving {{filename}}.
export_failed: Export failed. No content was downloaded.
empty_hint: Servers that have run and are stopped receive scheduled backups automatically. Select Back up now to create a manual backup.
jobs_empty: No recent backup, restore or export operations.
chain_pending: Restores the chosen backup once done
chain_abandoned: Not restored; the world was left as it was
chain_abandoned_snapshot_failed: Snapshot failed, so the world was left as it was
chain_abandoned_not_configured: Restoration not performed: restore service not configured
chain_abandoned_server_gone: Restoration not performed: server no longer exists
chain_abandoned_server_started: The server was started before the restore could run
chain_abandoned_restore_busy: Another restore is running on this world
restore_confirm: Restoring a backup will stop the server (all online players will be disconnected) and completely overwrite the current world with this backup. Without a safety snapshot this cannot be undone. Do you want to continue?
restore_confirm_safe: Restoration stops the server and disconnects online players, creates a safety snapshot of the current world, and overwrites the world with the selected backup after the snapshot succeeds. Restore the pre-restore snapshot if the result must be reversed. Confirm restoration?
safety_snapshot_label: Take a safety snapshot of the current world first (recommended)
safety_snapshot_hint: The restore starts once the snapshot succeeds; if it fails, nothing is restored and the world stays as it is.
safety_snapshot_off_hint: No safety snapshot will be created. The current world is overwritten directly. Existing data without another backup cannot be recovered.
stopping: Stopping the server. If players are online, an in-game notice is sent 30 seconds before disconnection…
stop_timeout: The server did not stop in time. Close this window and try again shortly.
corrupt_hint: Archive read-back verification failed. The archive cannot be restored intact. It is retained until expiry for investigation and can be deleted manually if no longer required.
skipped_entries_hint: Symbolic links and other non-regular entries were excluded from the archive and will not be included in restoration.
delete_confirm: The backup from {{relative}} ({{absolute}}), size {{size}}, will be removed from the list immediately and will no longer be available for restoration. This operation cannot be undone.
delete_cleanup_note: Its archive is removed at the next daily cleanup, and its off-site copy at the next sync.
delete_archive_warning: This backup is an archive created during world reclamation or server release. After deletion, world data without another recoverable copy cannot be restored.
delete_only_warning: This is the server’s only current backup.
delete_restore_busy: A restoration task may be reading this backup. Wait for restoration to complete before deleting it.
delete_gone: The backup no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
